info.title: Waste Organisations REST API
info.description: Create organisations with their addresses and read one by its id. Select v2 with the header `Accept: application/vnd.defra.waste-organisations+json; version=2`. A request without that media type, or without a `version`, is served v1. An unsupported, malformed or ambiguous version returns `406 Not Acceptable`.

post.description: Create an organisation with its addresses. Duplicate organisations are not detected.

parameters.name: Accept
parameters.description: Selects v2 of the API: `application/vnd.defra.waste-organisations+json; version=2`. Without it, or with `version=1`, the request is served v1.

406.description: Not Acceptable: the `Accept` header asks for an unsupported or malformed API version.

get.description: Returns the stored organisation with the given id as it is, with its current addresses.

parameters.name: Accept
parameters.description: Selects v2 of the API: `application/vnd.defra.waste-organisations+json; version=2`. Without it, or with `version=1`, the request is served v1.

406.description: Not Acceptable: the `Accept` header asks for an unsupported or malformed API version.

addressTypes.description: Every kind of address this currently is for the organisation. The order is not guaranteed.

addressLine.description:
The address on one line, computed in postal order with blank parts skipped and without the
country; never stored.

subBuildingName.description: A flat or unit within the building.

countryIso.description:
The country as an ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 code, upper-case. `GB` is the United Kingdom,
Northern Ireland included.

AddressDetailsResponse.description:
A current address of an organisation and the kinds of address it is for the organisation now.
Absent parts are omitted.

addressTypes.description: Every kind of address this is, each at most once. One item may list all five kinds.

subBuildingName.description: A flat or unit within the building.

buildingNumber.description: The building number, which may hold letters or a range, such as `12A` or `3-5`.

postalCode.description:
The postcode. Required when `countryIso` is `GB`; optional otherwise, because some
countries have no postcodes. Not checked against a format. Upper-cased, with each run of
whitespace inside it made one space, before it is stored and compared with stored addresses.

countryIso.description:
The country as an ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 code, upper-cased before it is checked. `GB` is
the United Kingdom, Northern Ireland included.

AddressRequest.description:
An address in the Defra standard address model, with the country as a two-letter code, and
the kinds of address it is. At least one of `subBuildingName`, `buildingName`,
`buildingNumber` and `poBox` must be given, so the premises can be identified.

addressTypes.description: Every kind of address this is for the organisation, in the order they were sent.

addressLine.description:
The address on one line, computed in postal order with blank parts skipped and without the
country; never stored.

subBuildingName.description: A flat or unit within the building.

countryIso.description:
The country as an ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 code, upper-case. `GB` is the United Kingdom,
Northern Ireland included.

AddressResponse.description: A stored address and the kinds of address it is for the organisation. Absent parts are omitted.

AddressType.description: A kind of address an organisation has.

CreateOrganisationRequest.description: The body of `POST /organisations`: the organisation to create, wrapped in an envelope.

CreateOrganisationResponse.description:
The body of a `201` from `POST /organisations`: the stored organisation, in the same
envelope as the request.

organisations.description: The organisation with the requested id: always exactly one item.

GetOrganisationDetailsResponse.description: The body of a `200` from the v2 `GET /organisations/{id}`.

id.description: The id, a UUIDv7 generated by the API.

name.description: The registered name; absent when none was sent.

tradingName.description: The name the organisation trades under; absent when none was sent.

companiesHouseNumber.description: The Companies House number; absent for a type not registered at Companies House.

regulatorNation.description: The nation whose regulator the organisation deals with.

organisationType.description: The organisation type code; absent when the organisation has no type.

validTo.description:
When this version of the organisation stopped being valid; absent while it is current.
ISO 8601 extended format with offset.

addresses.description:
One item per current address, carrying every kind it currently is for the organisation; an
empty array when there is none. The order is not guaranteed.

OrganisationDetailsResponse.description:
A stored organisation with its current addresses. Null members are omitted rather than written
as null, so consumers must treat an absent member as null.

name.description:
The registered name. Required for a type registered at Companies House; optional otherwise.
Must not be blank when present.

tradingName.description:
The name the organisation trades under. Required for a type not registered at Companies
House; optional otherwise. Must not be blank when present.

companiesHouseNumber.description:
The Companies House number: two letters or digits followed by six digits, for example
`12345678` or `SC123456`; upper-cased before it is checked. Required for a type
registered at Companies House and must be absent for every other type.

regulatorNation.description:
The nation whose regulator the organisation deals with, which for an overseas organisation
is not where it is based: `GB-ENG`, `GB-SCT`, `GB-WLS` or `GB-NIR`.

organisationType.description:
The organisation type, one of the published codes in upper snake case, matched exactly. The
type decides whether `name` or `tradingName` is required, whether
`companiesHouseNumber` is required or must be absent, and whether a `REGISTERED` or
a `PRINCIPAL` address is required.

Registered at Companies House: `name`, `companiesHouseNumber` and a `REGISTERED` address are required.

- `LTD`: Private limited company
- `PLC`: Public limited company
- `LIMITED_PARTNERSHIP`: Limited partnership
- `LLP`: Limited liability partnership
- `CIC`: Community interest company

Not registered at Companies House: `tradingName` and a `PRINCIPAL` address are required, and `companiesHouseNumber` must be absent.

- `SOLE_TRADER`: Sole trader
- `PARTNERSHIP`: General partnership
- `REGISTERED_SOCIETY`: Co-operative or community benefit society
- `CHARITABLE_ORGANISATION`: Charitable incorporated organisation or charitable trust
- `OVERSEAS_ORGANISATION`: Overseas organisation not registered in the UK

addresses.description:
One to five addresses, each listing in `addressTypes` every kind it serves as; a kind
may appear in one item only. Two items holding the same address come back as one item
carrying the kinds of both.

OrganisationRequest.description: An organisation to create. Every string is trimmed before it is validated and stored.

id.description: The id, a UUIDv7 generated by the API.

name.description: The registered name; absent when none was sent.

tradingName.description: The name the organisation trades under; absent when none was sent.

companiesHouseNumber.description: The Companies House number; absent for a type not registered at Companies House.

regulatorNation.description: The nation whose regulator the organisation deals with.

validFrom.description: When this version of the organisation became valid. ISO 8601 extended format with offset.

validTo.description:
When this version of the organisation stopped being valid; absent while it is current.
ISO 8601 extended format with offset.

createdAt.description: When the organisation was stored. ISO 8601 extended format with offset.

updatedAt.description: When the organisation was last changed. ISO 8601 extended format with offset.

addresses.description:
One item per stored address, in the order each first appeared in the request. Two request
items holding the same address come back as one item carrying the kinds of both.

OrganisationResponse.description:
A stored organisation, with every string as it was stored: trimmed, and
`companiesHouseNumber` upper-cased.

RegulatorNation.description:
The nation whose regulator an organisation deals with, as an ISO 3166-2:GB code. For an
overseas organisation this is not where it is based.
